pages.text: Tame a Nekker with raw meat. After a nonlethal victory a Rock Troll accepts you with sneak-use. Both heal from raw meat (+4 HP) or cooked meat (+6 HP). Use an empty hand for orders, and sneak-use for the Nekker inventory.
Tame a unicorn with a golden apple or golden carrot. Carrots and apples heal 4 HP, golden carrots 6, and golden apples 8. Equip a saddle to ride. A recovering unicorn cannot be fed.

Tame an exhausted Infernal Basilisk with a Molten Heart. Raw or cooked meat heals 4 or 6 HP, blaze powder 8 and blaze rods 12. Only the owner can feed; food is spent only on successful healing. Use an empty hand to mount.

Riding raises speed over 25 levels. Unicorns start at different speeds and all reach 22 blocks per second on level ground at maximum rank. Sneak-use with an empty hand to see the level and ridden distance in chat.
